one_liner: mosque.build is the lifecycle operating system for mosques: global discovery, planning, 3D design, permitting, budgeting, funding, sourcing, construction, management, waqf, and preservation.
why_now: Mosque communities increasingly coordinate digitally but still lack a purpose-built end-to-end project and operations platform.
Mapping, payments, geospatial data, 3D web technology, open architectural archives, mobile apps, and structured cloud backends now make a unified platform technically feasible.
Mosque construction and operations knowledge remains highly fragmented across countries, firms, committees, and generations.
Many communities need smaller, more sustainable, locally appropriate mosques rather than prestige construction without operating capacity.
moat: Global mosque knowledge graph and provenance layer
Mosque-specific geometry, qibla, saff, wudu, program and circulation intelligence
Network effects across mosque admins, builders, architects, donors and suppliers
business_models: Free public mosque directory and museum
Verified supplier marketplace and lead fees subject to transparent policies
Optional payment processing / donation software revenue
Enterprise/portfolio tools for foundations, waqf networks and mosque associations
Sponsored education and industry research with editorial separation
